tasks.label: go build and run (GUI)
tasks.command: $ws = '${workspaceFolder}'; $pName = Split-Path $ws -Leaf; if (-not (Test-Path 'go.mod')) { go mod init $pName }; $env:GOPROXY='https://proxy.golang.org,direct'; $env:GOSUMDB='off'; go mod tidy -v; $modDir = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'go/pkg/mod/github.com/pdfcpu'; $targets = Get-ChildItem -Path $modDir -Recurse -Include 'samples','testdata' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName; if ($targets) { Get-ChildItem -Path $targets -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $_.Attributes = 'Normal' }; Remove-Item -Path $targets -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; $rootDir = Split-Path $ws -Parent; $targetDir = Join-Path (Join-Path $rootDir '_bin') $pName; if (-not (Test-Path $targetDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetDir -Force | Out-Null }; $localBin = Join-Path $ws 'bin'; if (Test-Path $localBin) { robocopy $localBin $targetDir /E /XO /NJH /NJS /NDL /NC /NS | Out-Null }; $exePath = Join-Path $targetDir ($pName + '.exe'); Stop-Process -Name $pName -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; go build -ldflags="-H=windowsgui" -v -o $exePath .; if ($?) { Start-Process -FilePath $exePath -WorkingDirectory $targetDir }
